text:
Priya: Flagging an enrollment mismatch from this morning's ratecard import - ~350 accounts got assigned legacy credits incorrectly, affects cohort gating for the A/B experiment.
Daniel: Are these previews or live invoices?
Priya: Only previews so far (nightly job ran at 02:10). no final invoices yet.
Lea: Any sample account ids?
Priya: Samples: A-1122, A-4477, A-9900.
Priya: Vendor CSV showed legacy_credit as empty string for many rows but our ingest treated non-null as truthy.
Daniel: That would flip grandfathering flags. we use those flags to keep legacy customers on old pricing during rollouts.
Ethan: Product needs accurate cohort flags to approve canary tomorrow. recommendation?
Priya: My ask: pause new enrollments and disable preview emails until we fix parser and re-run ingest.
Lea: I'll patch the parser to strict-parse boolean and add schema validation. small diff: `legacy_credit = strip(val).lower() in ("true","1","yes")` and reject blank after strip.
billing-bot: Incident FIN-2301 created and assigned to Lea (priority P2). link: https://redwood.example/incidents/FIN-2301
Daniel: Finance: prepare a per-account delta report after backfill. thresholds: if projected rev delta >1% hold canary; if 0.25-1% allow limited enrollment (20% cap); <0.25% proceed.
Priya: I'll disable enrollments job enrollments-2024-04-02 and pause preview-email job.
Lea: Vendor ops, please resend cleaned CSV to /incoming with checksum.
Priya: Drafting CS note in case previews were shared: short reassurance, no invoices affected, regenerating previews. cc legal for wording.
Lea: Hotfix deployed to staging. running ingest on fixed file now. backfill job job-9305 queued (recompute previews + cohort flags). ETA 18m.
billing-bot: Backfill job queued: job-9305.
Priya: Finance will run reconciliation after backfill and post summary to FIN-2301. ETA 90m.
Ethan: Thanks. once reconciliation is attached i'll sign off on enrollment plan for the canary. :thumbsup:
Priya: Noted. will also confirm grandfathering parity: old_credit=true stays sticky for accounts previously marked true.
Lea: Ingest results: 0.44% accounts misflagged, projected ARR delta -0.33%. detailed per-account CSV attached to FIN-2301.
Daniel: Within threshold. product and finance ok to resume with conservative 20% enrollment cap for cohort B.
Priya: Re-enabled enrollments with 20% cap and re-enabled previews.
billing-bot: FIN-2301 marked resolved by Lea.
